brief:
Settlers set fire to a room and a vehicle in Osarin, a community located south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank, the Ma'an news agency reported. The attack added to mounting incidents of property destruction targeting Palestinian communities in the region.

Osarin has faced repeated confrontations with nearby settler outposts. The settlers involved in Wednesday's arson have not been identified, and Israeli security forces have not announced any investigation into the incident. Palestinian residents documented damage to the structures, though the full extent of losses remained under assessment.
title: Settlers torch room and vehicle in Osarin south of Nablus.
